input: Vienna-based reebuild raises €3 million to build the AI operating system for construction and real estate. reebuild, the Vienna-based AI-native back-office automation platform for construction and real estate, has raised €3 million.

Paris-based CarbonFarm raises €7 million to tackle methane emissions from rice farming. CarbonFarm, a Paris-based ClimateTech startup specialising in rice decarbonisation, has closed an oversubscribed round.

HyLight raises €13 million for its autonomous airships inspecting Europe's critical infrastructure. HyLight, the French startup specializing in aerial inspection of critical infrastructure, raised €13 million.

Ghent-based SpectaCell launches with €6 million to advance its cell analysis platform for immunotherapy development. SpectaCell, a new Ghent-based startup specialising in next-generation cell therapy analytics, launched with €6 million.
Whiterock deploys €82 million to support SME growth across Northern Ireland. Belfast-based fund manager Whiterock has announced their investment of €82 million (£70 million) in Northern Ireland SMEs.
One of Spain's largest recent FinTech deals sees ID Finance secure €545 million to scale Plazo. ID Finance, a Barcelona-based FinTech group, has announced €545 million of debt and equity funding.

Gaius Capital closes debut fund at €50 million, raises another €6 million via co-investment vehicle. Gaius Capital, a Berlin-based private equity firm focused on business succession in the DACH Mittelstand, closed its fund.

Profitable French scale-up Wiremind raises €35 million after 12 years of bootstrapping. Wiremind, a Paris-based AI software company serving the transport, air cargo, and events industries, raised €35 million.
Weekly funding round-up! All of the European startup funding rounds we tracked this week (Oct. 05 – Oct. 09). This article is visible for CLUB members only.
Monte Carlo Capital raises €13 million for Fund II to invest in early-stage DeepTech, AI and SpaceTech. Monte Carlo Capital (MCC), the Monaco-based early-stage venture firm investing at Seed.

case: Zurich B2B SaaS CHF 4M seed, expanding to Germany
input: Zurich-based Lumo raises CHF 4 million seed round to expand its B2B procurement software into Germany. The round was led by a Swiss VC.

input: Delft-based Photonix raises €5M seed to complete R&D on its photonic chips for data centres; commercial pilots planned for 2027.
